# Muhammad Aqib Javed

> Freelance Frontend & WordPress Developer based in Bahawalpur, Pakistan.

Muhammad Aqib Javed is a frontend and WordPress developer with 2+ years of experience building responsive, custom websites for clients. He specializes in HTML, CSS, Bootstrap, Tailwind CSS, JavaScript (ES6), and WordPress (including CPT UI, ACF, Elementor, and WPForms).

## Services
- Custom frontend website development (HTML, CSS, JavaScript)
- WordPress website development and customization
- Responsive, mobile-friendly web design
- Website bug fixes and maintenance
